merge into DIS_HOMEPAGE_STAT stat using ( select #{statId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} STAT_ID ,#{repId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} REP_ID ,#{statDate,jdbcType=DATE} STAT_DATE ,#{expectCounts,jdbcType=DECIMAL} EXPECT_COUNTS ,#{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} REMARK from dual ) temp
ON( stat.REP_ID = temp.REP_ID and stat.STAT_DATE = temp.STAT_DATE )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET stat.EXPECT_COUNTS = temp.EXPECT_COUNTS, stat.REMARK = temp.REMARK
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (STAT_ID ,REP_ID ,STAT_DATE ,EXPECT_COUNTS ,REMARK) VALUES(temp.STAT_ID,temp.REP_ID,temp.STAT_DATE,temp.EXPECT_COUNTS,temp.REMARK)
